name: Basilica of St. Charles Borromeo
history: St. Junípero Serra founded the mission at Monterey on 3 June 1770 and moved it to the mouth of the Carmel River in 1771, where it became the headquarters of all the Alta California missions until 1833. Serra led it until his death in 1784 and is buried there. After secularization it fell into ruin; the roof was rebuilt in 1884, and from 1931 Harry Downie spent fifty years restoring it.
arch: A sandstone mission church with a Moorish-style domed bell tower and a star-shaped window over the door. It is a National Historic Landmark.
features: It is the only California mission with its original bell and bell tower.
It holds the first library in California.

look.d: The only California mission tower with its original bell.
The star-shaped window above the door is the mission's signature.

fun: It was the site of the first Christian confirmation in Alta California, held while the mission was still at Monterey.
journal: Serra rests here. Sandstone, a star window, and fifty years of one man's restoration.
